title: Evergreen Account at a glance
summary: The “Evergreen Account at a glance” outlines: tree planting (1 tree per every $750 in eligible debit-card spending) and automatic carbon offset ($1.25 g CO2 per $1 spent), checking APY (0.05%), eco-friendly partner cashback (+1.75%), early direct deposit (up to 2 days early), and mobile check deposit limit ($3,500/day). It also lists foreign ATM fees (2% min $3.00 plus possible third-party fees), linked savings APY boosts (+0.55% with a Green Account; +0.15% with Diamond Elite Savings), and referral terms ($35 you earn, $25 they receive, up to 6 bonuses/year).
faqs: How does the Evergreen tree planting work, and what is the $750 threshold?
How much CO2 is offset per dollar spent, and is it automatic?
What are the Evergreen Account’s APY and partner eco brand cashback rates?
How many days early is direct deposit, and what is the mobile check deposit daily limit?
What are the foreign ATM withdrawal fees (including the $3.00 minimum)?
